_comment: Instants the live calendar feed emits that the committed schedule does not hold. Every entry must say why. See sports-viewer-meta/scripts/smoke-prod.mjs.

feedStartMismatch.why: The final at Hard Rock Stadium kicked off about 82 minutes late after crowd trouble at the gates. src/data/matches.js records the 21:15 EDT actual start; ESPN keeps the 20:00 EDT scheduled one.
